# Search for flights from Portland to San Jose on May 13, 2025, in economy class
search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Portland",
    end_airport_city="San Jose",
    departure_date=["May 13, 2025"],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Search for hotels in San Jose with gym and wifi amenities
search_hotels(
    city="San Jose",
    checkin_date=["May 13, 2025"],
    checkout_date=["May 15, 2025"],
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Get the flight results from cache
flights = get_results_from_cache(key="flights")

# Filter flights to ensure they match the criteria (economy class, one-way)
filtered_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=flights,
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Save the filtered flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_flights", value=filtered_flights)

# Get the hotel results from cache
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Filter hotels to ensure they match the criteria (gym and wifi)
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels,
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Search for restaurants in San Jose for a cultural trip
search_restaurants(
    city="San Jose",
    cuisine=["cultural"]
)

# Get the restaurant results from cache
restaurants = get_results_from_cache(key="restaurants")

# Filter restaurants to ensure they match the criteria (cultural cuisine)
filtered_restaurants = filter_restaurants(
    prior_results=restaurants,
    cuisine=["cultural"]
)

# Save the filtered restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants", value=filtered_restaurants)
